title: ARROWS AND ENTER IN THE PAUSE BOX
why: His number 39, full controller navigation, keyboard and mouse first. The pause box (ESC or TAB) answered only P, ESC and TAB from the keyboard, so its buttons could only be pressed with the mouse or a pad, while the title already took the arrows and ENTER. Now with the box up the arrow keys move a highlight across its buttons and ENTER or SPACE presses the highlighted one, the same press a click makes, so Abandon still asks and END RUN still asks twice.
now: The arrow keys and ENTER work the pause box buttons.

edits.replacement: if(pauseOpen&&code!=='KeyP'&&code!=='Escape'&&code!=='Tab'){ if(ev) ev.preventDefault(); if(!repeat){ keys[code]=false; pauseKeyNav(code); } return; }   // v23.97 (his #39): arrows and ENTER work the box

if(pauseOpen&&e.code!=='KeyP'&&e.code!=='Escape'&&e.code!=='Tab'){ e.preventDefault(); if(!e.repeat){ keys[e.code]=false; pauseKeyNav(e.code); } return; }   // v23.97 (his #39): arrows and ENTER work the box
